Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
Some interesting stats from Origins 2011:

- We had 71 players attend this year, a record!!!
- 49 of the 71 (69%) players got at least 1GW
- 24 got 1GW
- 11 got 2GW
- 8 got 3GW
- 4 got 4GW
- 1 got 6GW
- 1 got 7GW

- There were 132 games played, 101 (77%) of which had GWs

- Of the games that had no GW:
- 10 out of 31 were non-timeout ties, 21 (68%) were timeouts
- Of the 21 timeouts, 20 (95%) were at a 5-player table

Interesting stats, Kev!

> KevinM wrote:
> - Of the 21 timeouts, 20 (95%) were at a 5-player table

I don't think this one really means anything. If there were 95% of 5-player tables, then it means 4-player tables timeout as often as 5-player tables.

Do you have the % of 4-player tables timing out, and of 5-player tables timing out?

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
